scheme_name: Pre Matric Scholarship Scheme (Saral Vidya Sahay) for SC and OBC (V to VIII)
other_conditions: Applicant must be studying in classes 5th to 8th on a full‑time basis.
benefits_summary: Monthly stipend of ₹325 for 11 months, plus a merit scholarship of ₹900 per annum for classes 5‑6 or ₹1,000 per annum for classes 7‑8.
